Hawaiʻi: HRS 205 — district boundary changes require LUC approval.		land-use
Latent defectHidden defect not discoverable on reasonable inspection.national
Lateral supportRight to have land supported by neighboring land in its natural state.land-use
Lava zoneUSGS classification 1-9 of volcanic hazard risk. Lower number = higher risk. Affects insurance.
Hawaiʻi: Hawaii sellers must disclose lava zone on Big Island parcels.		hawaii
LeaseContract transferring possession + use for term in exchange for rent.contracts
Leasehold estateTenant's right to possess and use property for term.national
Lessor / LesseeLandlord / Tenant.national
LeverageUsing borrowed funds to amplify returns on invested capital.investment
License (land use)Permission to use land for a specific purpose; revocable at will.land-use
LienMonetary encumbrance attaching to property as security for debt.national
Life estateOwnership for duration of measuring life. Reverts to remainderman.national
Liquidated damagesPre-agreed damages amount. Often the earnest money in real estate.contracts
Lis pendensNotice of pending lawsuit that may affect title. Recorded with the land record.title
Listing agreementContract creating broker-seller relationship.agency
Littoral rightsRights of land abutting a non-flowing body of water (lake, ocean). Relevant in Hawaii.
Hawaiʻi: Hawaii's public-trust doctrine retains state title to land below the high-water mark.		land-use
Loan EstimateTRID form lender must provide within 3 business days of application. Lists costs + terms.closing
Loan-to-value (LTV)Loan amount ÷ appraised value. Lenders use this for risk + PMI thresholds.math
LTVLoan-to-Value. Loan ÷ Value. PMI required above 80% conventional.finance
Mandatory Seller's DisclosureHawaii sellers must provide Sellers Real Property Disclosure Statement (SRPDS) within timeframes.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 508D — disclosure must be material, accurate, signed.		hawaii
Marketable titleTitle free of significant clouds, acceptable to a reasonable buyer.title
Material factFact a reasonable buyer/seller would consider important.national
Mechanic's lienContractor/supplier lien for unpaid work or materials. HRS 507 in Hawaii.hawaii
Mechanics lienLien on property for unpaid labor/materials. Must be filed within statutory window.title
Megan's LawSex offender registration disclosure. State-specific agent duty rules.national
Mill / millage rate1/1000 of $1. Property tax expressed as mills per $1 of assessed value.math
Mill rateProperty tax rate. Tax = Assessed Value × (mills ÷ 1,000).math
MisrepresentationFalse statement of material fact. Innocent, negligent, or fraudulent.agency
MortgageSecurity instrument creating lender's lien on property.finance
Mrs. Murphy exemptionOwner-occupied 1-4 unit dwelling — limited federal Fair Housing exemption. Hawaii doesn't honor it.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 515 has no Mrs. Murphy carve-out; small landlords here must still comply.		fair-housing
Net leaseTenant pays rent + some property expenses. Triple-net (NNN) = tenant pays taxes, insurance, AND maintenance.management
Net listingBroker keeps amount above seller's minimum. Disfavored or banned.agency
Net Operating Income (NOI)Gross income − vacancy − operating expenses. Excludes debt service + taxes.investment
NOINet Operating Income. Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses.math
Nonconforming useExisting use that no longer matches current zoning but is allowed to continue (grandfathered).land-use
NovationSubstitution of new party or new contract by mutual agreement.contracts
OfferDefinite proposal communicated with intent to be bound on acceptance.contracts
Operating expense ratioOperating expenses ÷ effective gross income. Lower = more efficient property.investment
Option contractRight (not obligation) to buy at stated price within stated time.contracts
Patent defectObvious defect visible on reasonable inspection.national
PB (Principal Broker)Hawaii broker designated to supervise a firm. Required by HRS 467.
Hawaiʻi: Every Hawaii brokerage must have one designated PB.		hawaii
Percentage leaseRent = base + % of tenant's gross sales. Common in retail.management
Periodic tenancyLease that renews automatically (month-to-month).national
PITIPrincipal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance. Total monthly housing payment.finance
Planned Unit Development (PUD)Combination of individual unit ownership + shared common areas governed by HOA.property
PMIPrivate Mortgage Insurance. Required above 80% LTV conventional.finance
PMMPurchase Money Mortgage. Seller-financed mortgage at sale.finance
Point (discount)1% of loan amount, paid at closing to buy down interest rate.math
Police powerGovernment authority to regulate for health, safety, welfare. Source of zoning.national
Power of attorneyWritten authority for another to act for you.agency
Prepayment penaltyFee for paying off loan early. Restricted on most owner-occupied mortgages.finance
Prescriptive easementEasement acquired by open, notorious, continuous use for the statutory period (similar to adverse possession but use, not ownership).land-use
Principal(1) Loan amount. (2) Person agent represents.finance
ProbateCourt process administering deceased's estate.title
Procuring causeOrigin of unbroken chain producing sale. Determines commission entitlement.agency
Property managementGeneral agency: collect rents, maintain property, handle tenants.agency
Property management agreementWritten contract authorizing a manager to operate property for owner. Creates general agency.management
ProrationSplitting shared expenses at closing.math
Protected classes (federal)Race, color, religion, national origin, sex, familial status, disability. Seven federal classes.fair-housing
PUDPlanned Unit Development. Own lot + share in common areas.national
PuffingSubjective sales talk. Not actionable as misrepresentation.agency
Quiet title actionLawsuit to remove clouds on title and establish clear ownership.closing
Quitclaim deedConveys whatever interest grantor has. No warranties.title
RB / RS licenseHawaii license abbreviations: RB = Real Estate Broker; RS = Real Estate Salesperson.hawaii
Real Estate Commission (REC)Hawaii regulator. Sets rules, investigates, disciplines licensees.hawaii
Real propertyLand + permanent attachments + ownership rights.national
Reasonable accommodationRequired adjustment to rules/policies so a disabled person can equally use housing (e.g., service animal in no-pet building).fair-housing
Reasonable modificationRequired structural change a disabled tenant may make (at their cost) to use housing.fair-housing
RecordingFiling document with county recorder. Provides constructive notice.title
Recovery FundHawaii fund paying judgments against licensees who can't pay. Funded by license fees.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 467-16 — max $25K per transaction, $50K per licensee.		hawaii
RedliningRefusing to lend/insure in protected-class areas. Illegal.national
RemaindermanParty who receives a life estate property after the life tenant dies.property
RescissionTermination of contract returning parties to pre-contract position.contracts
RESPAReal Estate Settlement Procedures Act. Loan Estimate + Closing Disclosure rules.finance
Reverse mortgageLoan against home equity for seniors. Repaid when borrower dies/moves/sells.finance
Reversionary interestGrantor's right to get the property back after a life estate ends.property
Riparian rightsRights of owner of land bordering a watercourse.national
Salesperson licenseHawaii entry-level license. 18+, 60-hr course, PSI exam, sponsoring broker.hawaii
Sea level rise zoneHawaii planning overlay flagging properties at risk from coastal flooding by 2050+. Disclosure may apply.hawaii
Section (survey)1 square mile = 640 acres in the federal rectangular survey system.math
Security deposit (Hawaii)Hawaii caps residential at 1 month's rent. Must be returned within 14 days with itemized deductions.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 521-44 — 14 days, not 30.		management
Sellers marketDemand exceeds supply; prices rise.national
SetbackRequired distance between structure and property line.national
Settlement statementItemized list of all debits and credits for buyer and seller at closing.closing
SeveraltySole ownership by one person or entity.national
Sheriff's deedDeed issued by court after judicial foreclosure or execution sale.title
SMASpecial Management Area. Hawaii coastal-zone regulation.hawaii
Solar water heater requirementHawaii law requires solar water heaters on most new single-family construction since 2010.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 196-6.5 — variance available but rarely granted.		hawaii
Special Management Area (SMA)Hawaii coastal zone with extra permitting requirements. Restricts shoreline development.
Hawaiʻi: HRS 205A — protects shoreline; permits required for most coastal projects.		land-use
Specific performanceCourt orders actual conveyance. Buyer's remedy for seller breach.contracts
Spot zoningSingling out one parcel for different treatment. Generally unconstitutional.national
Square foot pricingSale price ÷ living-area square feet. Used in comparative market analysis.math
Statute of FraudsReal estate contracts must be in writing.contracts
SteeringChanneling buyers based on protected class. Fair housing violation.national

SubagencyAgent's authority delegated to another agent.agency
SubdivisionDivision of land into lots for sale or development.national
SubleaseTenant rents some or all of leasehold to a third party while remaining liable to landlord.management
SubordinationVoluntarily lowering lien priority to allow new senior lien.finance
SurveyProfessional measurement and mapping of parcel boundaries.national
Tax deedDeed issued after sale of property for unpaid taxes.title
TCTTransfer Certificate of Title. Hawaii Land Court conclusive title document.hawaii
Tenancy at sufferanceTenant holds over after lease ends without landlord consent.property
Tenancy at willLease terminable by either party at any time.national
Tenancy by the entiretySpousal co-ownership with survivorship + creditor protection.national
Tenancy in commonCo-ownership with separate inheritable shares. No survivorship.national

Time is of the essenceDeadlines strictly enforced. Late performance = breach.contracts
Time shareRight to occupy unit for set period each year.

Time-shareOwnership of intervals of use, typically in resort property. Heavily regulated in Hawaii.

Title insuranceProtects against title defects existing at closing.title
TMKTax Map Key. Hawaii's parcel ID: Zone-Section-Plat-Parcel(-CPR).hawaii
Township (survey)36 sections = 36 square miles in the rectangular survey system.math
TRIDTILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure rule — combined Loan Estimate + Closing Disclosure forms.closing

Trust account (PM)Separate account where property managers hold rents + deposits. Commingling is illegal.

Trustee's deedDeed issued by trustee after non-judicial foreclosure under power of sale.title

Unilateral contractOne party makes a promise; other accepts by performance (e.g., reward).contracts
Universal agentAuthority to act in all matters. Power of attorney.agency
UsuryCharging interest above legal cap. HRS 478 in Hawaii.hawaii

Instructor Evaluation Instrument

The following form is presented to every student upon completion of the Course. Responses are collected anonymously, tabulated quarterly, and retained for three years.

Student Evaluation of Instructor — Ralph Foulger's Academy of Real Estate

For each statement below, please indicate your agreement on a scale of 1 (Strongly Disagree) to 5 (Strongly Agree). Your responses are anonymous and will be reviewed quarterly to improve the Academy's instructional quality.

#StatementScale
1The instructor demonstrated thorough knowledge of the subject matter.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
2Course content was presented clearly and at an appropriate pace.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
3The instructor was responsive to student questions.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
4Examples used in instruction were relevant to Hawai'i practice.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
5The instructor began and ended class sessions on time.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
6Course materials were complete, accurate, and free of errors.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
7Assessment items (quizzes and exams) fairly reflected the material taught.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
8I feel prepared to take the PSI Real Estate Salesperson Examination.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5
9I would recommend this Course to another aspiring licensee.1 — 2 — 3 — 4 — 5

[ DAY ] day of [ MONTH ], 20[ YY ]

Principal Instructor & Founder
Cert No. [ XXXX-YYYY ]

The Certificate is printed on tamper-evident bond paper, signed in ink, and embossed with the Academy seal.
